gate.case: U011 5000-record domain and MemoryAdapter first-page budgets
outside_adapter_clock: initial Map write and eager validated open

findings.title: An unconfirmed install and a confirmed commit can leave an indistinguishable synced receipt
findings.expected: Recover the exact old bytes after failed final confirmation; keep an ambiguous outcome fenced. Retain the candidate after a confirmed commit.
findings.actual: If final parent sync fails and the process stops before compensating rename, or that rename fails leaving SYNCED visible, recovery verifies both hashes, freshly syncs, unlinks the receipt and leaves the candidate active.
findings.basis: Static control flow. Existing tests cover successful compensation and a crash after confirmed commit separately.
findings.how_to_test: On disposable v3 and v5 copies, interrupt after failed parent-sync visit 6 before compensation, and separately fail the compensating rename. Compare with interruption after successful visit 6. Reopen under fresh ownership and check fencing, active state bytes/hash, retained backup and all named originals.

findings.title: Interrupted first preimage copy can prevent unattended retry
findings.evidence: create_new writes directly to the final digest-named path. A previously present partial copy is preserved and rejected. With no intent, recovery returns immediately.
findings.confirm_or_falsify: Interrupt the first copy after a partial write on a disposable fixture; inspect the final name, reopen and retry twice. Determine whether a partial file persists and blocks retry while the original state and media remain intact.

findings.title: A second parse of identical authoritative text dominated the later measurement
findings.evidence: One eager parse outside the clock, then another inside for the same 6847994 UTF-8 bytes. Timed parse 112.267 ms of 132.048 ms; date check and row count loop 1.153 ms.
findings.proposed_for_cine_confirmation: One-shot reuse of an exclusively read-only, fully validated snapshot on the first summary after successful open. Always getItem in the original clock, compare full non-null strings, and validate the freshly read value on a miss. Compute counts for the current date.
findings.confirm_or_falsify: Check eager and deferred preview opens, cross-handle edits, invalid and missing data, writes including failed writes, date and error precedence, and no media access or storage writes. Retain default scheduling and assertions; check heap cost, equality cost and real hit rate.
